000.evidence: Head and chin lifted, both irises at upper edges of original white eyes; nose above neutral.

202.5.evidence: Head pitched down and nose shifted left of chest center; both eyes aim toward lower-left keys.

247.5.evidence: Native-size side-by-side review against level-left and stronger down-left: nose/muzzle and chin are slightly lower than level-left, while face remains yawed left; stronger down-left neighbor continues downward pitch. Vertical cue is subtle and blind reviewers called it ambiguous, so retain explicit readability warning.

270.evidence: Head yaws screen-left, nose at left of head center and eyes tracking left; body stays frontal.

292.5.evidence: Leftward head yaw with chin/nose raised and irises rotated toward upper-left.

315.evidence: Muzzle lifted and left of center, both eyes aimed diagonally up-left.

337.5.evidence: Head nearly frontal and raised toward up, pupils slightly left/up. Horizontal component is subtle near vertical; continuation into up is coherent.

continuity_visual_review.alpha_hole_warning_resolution: Reported rows lie between feet near ground and between ear tufts at top silhouette; inspected light-background labeled sheet has no transparent interior belly/face holes or seam bands.
continuity_visual_review.center_shift_warning_resolution: 135 to 157.5 bounds center moves as head bends farther down-right; keyboard, feet and seated lower body stay anchored. No whole-sprite shift.
continuity_visual_review.loop_boundaries: 157.5 to 180 brings bowed face toward center without changing body/board size; 337.5 to000 continues raised head toward vertical.
continuity_visual_review.limitations: Three independent blind reviewers passed all hard cardinal gates and every horizontal axis. Near-horizontal 112.5 and247.5 have subtle downward pitch accepted only after native-size adjacent-pose review; no wrong direction or neutral replacement identified.

independent_blind_review.resolution: Both reviewed beside neighbors at native size; true but small downward head/muzzle displacement; accepted as intermediate readability warnings, atlas bytes unchanged.
